description: This file defines the HttpService class which provides methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to a configured API endpoint. It manages serialization/deserialization of data and shows toast notifications on errors.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class that encapsulates HTTP communication logic, including GET, POST, PUT, DELETE operations, with JSON serialization and error handling.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request, deserializes response to specified type.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request, deserializes response.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with data, handles error serialization, and shows toast notifications on error.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with data, with error handling and toast notifications.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON StringContent for HTTP requests.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes the HTTP response content into the specified type.
